note: For risk_model_v2 (card history; feedback #4), 2026-10-23. The flag line was CHOSEN ON THE VALIDATION SLICE (the latest 10% of the training period: not trained on, but also used for early stopping), not on the test file. To be open: the rule was set after a review of the test file showed v2 at 0.5 catches fewer first frauds than v1. The rule: the lowest line whose false alarms on that slice do not exceed what model v1 at 0.5 raised there (85): 0.15 gives 68 (0.1 would give 97). On the untouched test file this catches 1,804 of 2,145 frauds with 284 false alarms (v1 at 0.5: 1,427 and 397), and catches the FIRST fraud on 163 of 218 cards (v1: 152). rules_v1.json (0.5 with model v1) is kept for comparison. Change these numbers (and rules_version) to move the lines; no code change needed. hold_at stays 0.9 from v1 (v2 at 0.9: 12 false alarms on the test file, v1: 35); flag and hold both give a soft decline at the till.
